parsed.corrected_rationale: The comment explicitly identifies the missing definitions for "LLH" and "ECE" and notes that "OOD" has already been defined. It also states that "ECE" is a pivotal metric, implying that its definition is crucial. The authors can directly identify the action they need to take: define the abbreviations "LLH" and "ECE" in the draft. This action is explicit and concrete — the authors know exactly which abbreviations need defining and how to apply the fix (i.e., add a definition at first use), even though the reviewer does not spell out the full terms or the exact placement. The rubric does not require the reviewer to supply the content of the fix itself; it only requires that authors clearly know what to do and how to apply it. The comment therefore contains an explicit action paired with concrete implementation guidance, which matches the rubric's description of the appropriate actionability level.
